conversation._note: The chat's reply memory (DS022 "Composing a base memory", DS023 "Conversation layer"): composed from these layers when it is missing; rebuild it with other layers on /admin (base-memory composer).
conversation.name: Conversation (default set)

queryParser._note: Owner decision 2026-10-02: formalization is step by step only (LLMDirect archived in probably_obsolete/one-shot-formalization/). Each question goes to the first tier of the ladder and escalates to the next only when its answer cannot be read or the tier does not answer. How a tier's model reasons (thinking off, a low reasoning effort, a minimum token budget) is set on the tier entry in Ploinky Workers, where the provider is known (DS027 "Reasoning settings"), not in these requests.

adapter._note: ChatSOPAdapter (lib/adapter, owner decision 2026-10-03): the one backend of the chat, the API and every evaluation. mode: stepwise (the step-by-step formalizer, queryParser), routed (structure -> compute path B with jsEval and engineCode as second formalizations, FOL v2 otherwise; two formalizations that agree verify the answer) or direct-verified (the direct tier answers, the routed formalizations try to verify it). A session (setting adapter_mode) or a request (adapter: {mode, options}) may choose another mode. Tiers are proxy tiers.

mrp._note: MRP-LLM models (DS025): the model answering requests that name none. Models live under <chatData.root>/models; profiles in config/profiles.
